## Purpose
A `XxxRow` interface is the per-entity result shape a fan-out hook or a list-fetching wrapper hands back to a list-rendering component: `ArtifactDriftRow`/`ProjectDetectionRow` from the hooks fan-out over registered projects, `SpecRow`/`SessionRow` from `lib/dashboard.ts`'s per-spec/per-session projections. All four bundle the entity's identity plus whatever the list UI needs to render one line, so the consuming `.map()` never has to re-derive loading/error state or re-shape backend fields.

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/hooks/**, apps/dashboard/src/lib/** · Extension: .ts · Files of this role in this subproject: 4
A hook-level `XxxRow` (from a `useQueries` fan-out) carries the source entity's identity field, the resolved `data` (optional/undefined while loading), an explicit `isLoading: boolean`, and an `error: unknown` — mirroring `UseQueryResult`'s shape but flattened for easy destructuring by the caller. A lib-level `XxxRow` (a server projection, e.g. `SpecRow`, `SessionRow`) instead carries plain data fields straight off the backend DTO, snake_case field names preserved, with `| null` used liberally for backend-optional fields rather than `?`. Both kinds are plain `export interface`, never `type`, and are exported for the consuming page's own type annotations.

## How to apply
A new hook fan-out row goes next to its `useQueries` hook (see `useArtifactDrift.ts`), named `<Entity>Row`, and reuses the `{ path/identity, data, isLoading, error }` shape. A new server-projection row goes in `lib/dashboard.ts` (or a topical `lib/*.ts`) next to the `fetch*` function that returns `Xxx[]`, keeping snake_case fields identical to the Rust struct it mirrors.

## Examples
Ref: apps/dashboard/src/hooks/useArtifactDrift.ts
```ts
export interface ArtifactDriftRow {
  path: string;
  report: ArtifactDriftReport | undefined;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: unknown;
}
```

Ref: apps/dashboard/src/hooks/useProjectDetections.ts
```ts
export interface ProjectDetectionRow {
  project: ProjectEntry;
  detection: ProjectDetection | undefined;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: unknown;
}
```

Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/dashboard.ts
```ts
export interface SpecRow {
  name: string;
  status: string | null;
  phase: string | null;
  started_at: string | null;
  completed_at: string | null;
  affected_files: string[];
  bucket: SpecBucket | null;
  parent: string | null;
}
```
